data.title: Tetr1s Tower
data.about:
Tetr1s Tower by Object 1 at JVC Dubai is an architectural marvel that redefines modern living. Featuring a sleek, curved design that embodies Dubai’s commitment to luxury and innovation, the tower offers a unique living experience. Its interconnected sections symbolize unity and individuality, setting a new standard for contemporary residential design. The residences, ranging from studio to 2-bedroom apartments, provide spacious living areas and breathtaking views, perfect for those seeking a refined lifestyle.

Beyond the stunning architecture, Tetr1s Tower offers an exceptional range of amenities. Residents can enjoy a state-of-the-art fitness center, landscaped gardens, an infinity pool, and a tranquil terrace-level pool for relaxation and rejuvenation. Wellness is central to the community, with a jogging track and meditation area designed for peaceful moments. A flexible payment plan ensures accessibility for investors, while the prime location in Jumeirah Village Circle provides excellent connectivity to key areas in Dubai. Tetr1s Tower isn’t just a place to live; it’s a vibrant community that enhances everyday living.

characteristics_module.title: Tetr1s Tower – Where Modern living Blends With Artistic Flair
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Architectural Excellence: Unique curved design that blends modern aesthetics with functional living spaces.
  • High-End Finishes: Premium quality materials and finishes throughout, enhancing comfort and luxury.
  • Exclusive Amenities: Residents enjoy top-tier facilities, including fitness centers, swimming pools, and leisure areas.
  • Flexible Living Options: Spacious units ranging from studio apartments to 2.5-bedroom homes.
  • Community & Convenience: Close proximity to schools, hospitals, retail centers, and leisure attractions in JVC.
  • Dynamic Lifestyle: Perfect blend of vibrant city living and peaceful residential ambiance, offering an oasis within the city.
  • Strategic Connectivity: Easy access to key commercial, retail, and entertainment hubs in Dubai, including Dubai Marina and Downtown Dubai.

location_tile.title: Tetr1s Tower – Enjoy a Central Location in JVC, Dubai
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Tetr1s Tower at JVC offers a prime location in the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle, where urban vibrancy meets tranquility. With easy access to Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and other key destinations, Tetr1s Tower provides residents the perfect balance of city life and peaceful surroundings. Its central location ensures excellent connectivity, while the surrounding community offers serene green spaces, top-notch amenities, and essential services, making it a perfect choice for both relaxation and convenience.

  • 15  Minutes to Jumeirah Golf Estates Golf Course 
  • 15  Minutes to the Mall of the Emirates 
  • 17  Minutes to Dubai Hills Mall 
  • 20  Minutes to The Walk JBR 
  • 22  Minutes to Palm Jumeirah 
  • 25  Minutes to Motiongate Theme Park  
  • 27  Minutes to Legoland Dubai
